elements.label: Figure 6.13
elements.title: Dataset with an Inner and Outer Ring

details.values: Points scattered forming two distinct rings: an inner ring roughly centered near (0,0) with radius about 3-5 units, and an outer ring forming a larger circle around it with radius about 8-10 units.

elements.summary: This scatter plot shows a dataset with two distinct clusters forming an inner and outer ring, illustrating a case where k-means clustering would struggle but density-based clustering like DBScan might perform better.
